set: A: one sheet across each beat, the page turn and the slab seating

issues.what: the scattered keycaps hang weightless in mid-air over the form fields and keyboard for what is roughly two seconds of playback, with motion-streak blur but no fall, no tumbling descent and no landing; the keyboard body and the fields under the overlap do not react at all when the keys pop out, so nothing answers the event and the scatter reads as moved-by-hand, not as sprung keys with mass
issues.fix: give the keycaps an arc with gravity: rise, slow at the peak, then drop and settle onto the keyboard deck and fields with a visible contact frame (a small bounce or stop-dead on land); add a flex or kick to the keyboard slab at the moment the keys blow out so the machine reacts too

issues.where: the on-screen keyboard through the typing beat, frames 0:16.00 to 0:23.97
issues.what: keys register only as an orange highlight; in none of the twelve sampled frames does a key visibly travel down and spring back, so the keypress reads as a selection flash rather than a physical key going down with a return
issues.fix: add visible key travel on struck keys (down a millimetre or two with a tightened contact shadow, then a fast spring back), so at least some sampled frames catch a mid-press

issues.where: the Invalid email tags, frames 0:32.17 to 0:33.97
issues.what: the red tags appear already in place with no arrival or settle, and the sequence ends on a frame with a motion-blurred duplicate tag while two others sit static, so a single middle frame is hard to read: it is not clear whether a tag is spawning, splitting or being dragged away
issues.fix: give each tag a tiny pop-in with overshoot and settle, and make the exit drag directional so the blurred tag clearly leaves the stack rather than duplicating it

issues.where: the page turn start, frames 0:45.40 to 0:45.77
issues.what: there is a hold before and after the turn and the slab seats with mass (confirmed sharp-by-0:46.23 and dead-stable through 0:46.57 on the native consecutive sheet set-A-09), but the sampled frames show no wind-up: the page is static at 0:45.67 and already deeply folded by 0:45.77, so the big action starts abruptly with no anticipation visible at this sampling
issues.fix: if the source frames allow, let the slab lift or breathe a frame or two before it commits to the fold so the turn reads as wound-up rather than triggered
